name: Deck Suggestions
author: eruizimade
summary: What to play next, from Backspins on your computer: filter by key, tempo, energy, stars and MyTags.
description:
When a deck loads a track, from a USB stick or from rekordbox over Pro DJ Link, a panel shows the six best follow-ups with fit, stars, BPM, key and why, picked by Backspins (the rekordbox toolkit) from your own sets. Tap filters (key, BPM, energy, stars, MyTags) to narrow them. Tracks that play for 45 seconds are sent back so they teach it.

Needs Backspins with Deck link on, on the same network. Uses the network only to reach it. Changes no control, audio or library.
